source_snapshot.items: Verify BMC serial log excludes restore_uboot_env_data
source_snapshot.procedure: Attach COM/ttyS0, AC off, AC on, and collect the BMC serial log.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 5 attended/10 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; correctly reserves physical serial attachment and AC cycling to an operator, with agent grep of supplied log.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/CRITICAL; requires approved electrical fixture, all-feed AC proof, complete gap-free boot capture, negative-evidence validity and recovery.

old_problem: Serial pinout/settings, complete AC boundary, capture window and continuity were missing. An empty/truncated or late-started log cannot prove absence of an early U-Boot token, but these details can be safely parameterized.
disposition_reason: ED-06/09/16/18/20/24/30 preserve physical serial and full AC OFF→ON→BMC-ready coverage while allowing fixture, feed map, dwell and token normalization as runtime project configuration. The review defines a complete immutable evidence window and forbids automatic cycle retry; no engineering semantic remains to invent.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2234, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2235 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00017-V001 / 54953745bbbcae5b was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
A qualified operator must verify ttyS0 header pinout, voltage, ground/isolation, adapter and baud/parity/data/stop/flow settings before attachment.
Drain workloads, map every PSU/feed/PDU outlet and authorize a true all-feed AC cycle; host shutdown or one-feed removal is not equivalent.
Start unfiltered timestamped raw serial capture before AC removal, prove standby-power loss and dwell, restore feeds in approved order, and capture continuously through the signed BMC-ready marker.
Validate file immutability, byte/timestamp continuity and gap report before searching exact and approved normalized token forms.
No match is PASS evidence only when the complete window is proven; empty, truncated, filtered or late capture is BLOCKED/invalid evidence.
Stop on console loss, feed ambiguity, boot/power fault or incomplete window; no automatic repeat of the cycle.
No serial attachment, AC cycle, capture, retry, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Gap-free BMC ttyS0 log across complete AC cycle excludes restore_uboot_env_data
test_case.purpose: Observe the earliest BMC boot path across true all-feed AC removal/restoration and prove the forbidden U-Boot restoration token is absent from a complete immutable serial transcript.
required_package: Exact SUT/BMC firmware and approved ttyS0 header/pinout/electrical adapter/settings
All-feed PSU/PDU map, safe shutdown, AC-off proof, dwell, restore order and final state
Capture start/end/BMC-ready markers, continuity criteria and token case/encoding/normalization rules
Maintenance authorization and independent power/console recovery
test_case.test_command: A qualified operator starts an unfiltered timestamped ttyS0 capture before authorized all-feed AC removal, proves OFF and dwell, restores feeds in order, and records continuously through BMC Ready. Hash and validate the raw artifact/gaps, then search exact and approved normalized `restore_uboot_env_data` forms without modifying the capture.
test_case.expected_result: A continuous valid transcript covers pre-off, complete AC OFF, AC ON and BMC Ready with no occurrence of the forbidden token in any approved form; requested final power/host state is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires proven electrical/target identity, complete all-feed AC boundary, gap-free immutable capture and zero approved-form matches. Any match is FAIL; incomplete/empty/truncated/late capture, ambiguous feed state or missing Ready boundary cannot pass. Missing bindings blocks execution, not review.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until fixture electrical compatibility, all-feed map, workload drain, power authorization and recovery are signed.
Operator-only serial attachment and AC control; agent may analyze only the supplied artifact.
No filtering during acquisition and no automatic repeat cycle.
Stop on console loss, partial-feed ambiguity, power/boot fault or incomplete window.
expected_evidence: Authorization, all-feed topology and independent OFF/ON/Ready timestamps
Raw hashed serial artifact with markers and gap/continuity report
Search command/version, normalization policy, match count/context
Final power/host recovery evidence and no-repeat audit
test_case.recovery: On console, power or boot anomaly, preserve the partial artifact and do not repeat automatically. Use the signed independent power/console recovery plan to reach the requested final state; a new cycle needs new authorization.

source_conflict.reason: The source consistently requires ttyS0 capture across AC off/on and absence of one token.

blocked.reason: The physical method and token oracle are clear; fixture, power and completeness parameters are supplyable.
